conversations_archive_timestamp_check.name: conversations_archive_timestamp_check
conversations_archive_timestamp_check.value:
(
        ("conversations"."lifecycle" = 'active' AND "conversations"."archived_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("conversations"."lifecycle" = 'archived' AND "conversations"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )

conversation_messages_shape_check.name: conversation_messages_shape_check
conversation_messages_shape_check.value:
(
        (
          "conversation_messages"."kind" = 'opening'
          AND "conversation_messages"."role" = 'assistant'
          AND "conversation_messages"."content" IS NOT NULL
          AND LENGTH("conversation_messages"."content") > 0
          AND "conversation_messages"."client_request_id" IS NULL
          AND "conversation_messages"."in_reply_to" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "conversation_messages"."kind" = 'user'
          AND "conversation_messages"."role" = 'user'
          AND "conversation_messages"."content" IS NOT NULL
          AND LENGTH("conversation_messages"."content") > 0
          AND "conversation_messages"."in_reply_to" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "conversation_messages"."kind" = 'generated'
          AND "conversation_messages"."role" = 'assistant'
          AND "conversation_messages"."content" IS NULL
          AND "conversation_messages"."client_request_id" IS NULL
          AND "conversation_messages"."in_reply_to" IS NOT NULL
        )
      )

generation_attempts_terminal_timestamp_c.name: generation_attempts_terminal_timestamp_check
generation_attempts_terminal_timestamp_c.value:
(
        ("generation_attempts"."status" IN ('complete', 'interrupted', 'failed') AND "generation_attempts"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("generation_attempts"."status" IN ('pending', 'streaming') AND "generation_attempts"."completed_at" IS NULL)
      )

generation_attempts_usage_shape_check.name: generation_attempts_usage_shape_check
generation_attempts_usage_shape_check.value:
(
        ("generation_attempts"."input_tokens" IS NULL AND "generation_attempts"."output_tokens" IS NULL AND "generation_attempts"."usage_is_estimated" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("generation_attempts"."input_tokens" IS NOT NULL AND "generation_attempts"."output_tokens" IS NOT NULL AND "generation_attempts"."usage_is_estimated" IS NOT NULL)
      )

generation_attempts_lease_shape_check.name: generation_attempts_lease_shape_check
generation_attempts_lease_shape_check.value:
(
        ("generation_attempts"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND "generation_attempts"."lease_owner" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("generation_attempts"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "generation_attempts"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL)
      )

quota_buckets_scope_check.name: quota_buckets_scope_check
quota_buckets_scope_check.value:
(
        ("quota_buckets"."scope" = 'user' AND "quota_buckets"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("quota_buckets"."scope" = 'instance' AND "quota_buckets"."user_id" IS NULL)
      )

quota_buckets_period_check.name: quota_buckets_period_check
quota_buckets_period_check.value:
(
        (
          "quota_buckets"."scope" = 'user'
          AND "quota_buckets"."period_start" = DATE_TRUNC('day', "quota_buckets"."period_start" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
          AND "quota_buckets"."period_end" = (("quota_buckets"."period_start" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') + INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        )
        OR
        (
          "quota_buckets"."scope" = 'instance'
          AND "quota_buckets"."period_start" = DATE_TRUNC('month', "quota_buckets"."period_start" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
          AND "quota_buckets"."period_end" = (("quota_buckets"."period_start" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') + INTERVAL '1 month') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        )
      )

quota_reservations_terminal_shape_check.name: quota_reservations_terminal_shape_check
quota_reservations_terminal_shape_check.value:
(
        (
          "quota_reservations"."status" = 'active'
          AND "quota_reservations"."settled_at" IS NULL
          AND "quota_reservations"."released_at" IS NULL
          AND "quota_reservations"."settled_input_tokens" IS NULL
          AND "quota_reservations"."settled_output_tokens" IS NULL
          AND "quota_reservations"."usage_is_estimated" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "quota_reservations"."status" = 'settled'
          AND "quota_reservations"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "quota_reservations"."released_at" IS NULL
          AND "quota_reservations"."settled_input_tokens" IS NOT NULL
          AND "quota_reservations"."settled_output_tokens" IS NOT NULL
          AND "quota_reservations"."usage_is_estimated" IS NOT NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "quota_reservations"."status" = 'released'
          AND "quota_reservations"."settled_at" IS NULL
          AND "quota_reservations"."released_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "quota_reservations"."settled_input_tokens" IS NULL
          AND "quota_reservations"."settled_output_tokens" IS NULL
          AND "quota_reservations"."usage_is_estimated" IS NULL
        )
      )

usage_ledger_workload_shape_check.name: usage_ledger_workload_shape_check
usage_ledger_workload_shape_check.value:
(
        (
          "usage_ledger"."workload_type" = 'chat_generation'
          AND "usage_ledger"."background_operation_id" IS NULL
          AND "usage_ledger"."memory_extraction_run_id" IS NULL
          AND "usage_ledger"."relationship_summary_version_id" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "usage_ledger"."workload_type" IN ('memory_extraction', 'summary_refresh')
          AND "usage_ledger"."user_id" IS NULL
          AND "usage_ledger"."conversation_id" IS NULL
          AND "usage_ledger"."attempt_id" IS NULL
          AND "usage_ledger"."background_operation_id" IS NULL
          AND "usage_ledger"."memory_extraction_run_id" IS NULL
          AND "usage_ledger"."relationship_summary_version_id" IS NULL
          AND "usage_ledger"."user_request_units" = 0
        )
        OR
        (
          "usage_ledger"."workload_type" = 'memory_extraction'
          AND "usage_ledger"."background_operation_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "usage_ledger"."user_request_units" = 0
          AND "usage_ledger"."relationship_summary_version_id" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "usage_ledger"."workload_type" = 'summary_refresh'
          AND "usage_ledger"."background_operation_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "usage_ledger"."user_request_units" = 0
          AND "usage_ledger"."memory_extraction_run_id" IS NULL
        )
      )

user_chat_quota_overrides_has_value_chec.name: user_chat_quota_overrides_has_value_check
user_chat_quota_overrides_has_value_chec.value: "user_chat_quota_overrides"."daily_request_limit" IS NOT NULL OR "user_chat_quota_overrides"."daily_token_limit" IS NOT NULL

account_deletion_requests_verification_s.name: account_deletion_requests_verification_shape_check
account_deletion_requests_verification_s.value:
(
        (
          "account_deletion_requests"."status" = 'pending_confirmation'
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."user_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."verification_token_hash" IS NOT NULL
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."verification_expires_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."verification_consumed_at" IS NULL
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."confirmed_at" IS NULL
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."locked_at" IS NULL
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."completed_at" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "account_deletion_requests"."status" IN ('locked', 'purging', 'dead_letter')
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."user_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."verification_token_hash" IS NULL
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."verification_expires_at" IS NULL
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."verification_consumed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."completed_at" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "account_deletion_requests"."status" = 'complete'
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."verification_token_hash" IS NULL
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."verification_expires_at" IS NULL
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."verification_consumed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "account_deletion_requests"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
        )
      )

background_model_reservations_period_che.name: background_model_reservations_period_check
background_model_reservations_period_che.value:
(
        "background_model_reservations"."period_start" = DATE_TRUNC('month', "background_model_reservations"."period_start" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        AND "background_model_reservations"."period_end" = (("background_model_reservations"."period_start" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') + INTERVAL '1 month') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
      )

data_export_jobs_archive_digest_check.name: data_export_jobs_archive_digest_check
data_export_jobs_archive_digest_check.value:
"data_export_jobs"."archive_sha256" IS NULL OR (
        "data_export_jobs"."archive_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        AND "data_export_jobs"."archive_bytes" IS NOT NULL
        AND "data_export_jobs"."archive_sha256" = ENCODE(SHA256("data_export_jobs"."archive_bytes"), 'hex')
      )

data_export_jobs_archive_shape_check.name: data_export_jobs_archive_shape_check
data_export_jobs_archive_shape_check.value:
(
        (
          "data_export_jobs"."status" = 'complete'
          AND "data_export_jobs"."archive_bytes" IS NOT NULL
          AND "data_export_jobs"."archive_size" IS NOT NULL
          AND "data_export_jobs"."archive_size" = OCTET_LENGTH("data_export_jobs"."archive_bytes")
          AND "data_export_jobs"."archive_sha256" IS NOT NULL
          AND "data_export_jobs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "data_export_jobs"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "data_export_jobs"."expires_at" = "data_export_jobs"."completed_at" + INTERVAL '24 hours'
        )
        OR
        (
          "data_export_jobs"."status" <> 'complete'
          AND "data_export_jobs"."archive_bytes" IS NULL
          AND "data_export_jobs"."archive_size" IS NULL
          AND "data_export_jobs"."archive_sha256" IS NULL
          AND "data_export_jobs"."expires_at" IS NULL
        )
      )

memory_evidence_source_shape_check.name: memory_evidence_source_shape_check
memory_evidence_source_shape_check.value:
(
        ("memory_evidence"."source_message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "memory_evidence"."source_deleted_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("memory_evidence"."source_message_id" IS NULL AND "memory_evidence"."source_attempt_id" IS NULL AND "memory_evidence"."source_deleted_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )

memory_extraction_executions_tokens_chec.name: memory_extraction_executions_tokens_check
memory_extraction_executions_tokens_chec.value:
"memory_extraction_executions"."estimated_input_tokens" >= 0 AND "memory_extraction_executions"."estimated_output_tokens" >= 0
      AND ("memory_extraction_executions"."input_tokens" IS NULL OR "memory_extraction_executions"."input_tokens" >= 0)
      AND ("memory_extraction_executions"."output_tokens" IS NULL OR "memory_extraction_executions"."output_tokens" >= 0)
      AND "memory_extraction_executions"."latency_ms" >= 0

memory_extraction_executions_receipt_sha.name: memory_extraction_executions_receipt_shape
memory_extraction_executions_receipt_sha.value:
("memory_extraction_executions"."settled_at" IS NULL OR ("memory_extraction_executions"."response_at" IS NOT NULL AND "memory_extraction_executions"."candidates" IS NULL))
      AND ("memory_extraction_executions"."candidates" IS NULL OR (JSONB_TYPEOF("memory_extraction_executions"."candidates") = 'array' AND JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH("memory_extraction_executions"."candidates") <= 20))

memory_extraction_runs_usage_shape_check.name: memory_extraction_runs_usage_shape_check
memory_extraction_runs_usage_shape_check.value:
(
        ("memory_extraction_runs"."input_tokens" IS NULL AND "memory_extraction_runs"."output_tokens" IS NULL AND "memory_extraction_runs"."usage_estimated" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("memory_extraction_runs"."input_tokens" IS NOT NULL AND "memory_extraction_runs"."output_tokens" IS NOT NULL AND "memory_extraction_runs"."usage_estimated" IS NOT NULL)
      )

memory_extraction_runs_terminal_shape_ch.name: memory_extraction_runs_terminal_shape_check
memory_extraction_runs_terminal_shape_ch.value:
(
        ("memory_extraction_runs"."status" IN ('complete', 'failed', 'dead_letter', 'cancelled') AND "memory_extraction_runs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("memory_extraction_runs"."status" IN ('pending', 'queued', 'running', 'retrying') AND "memory_extraction_runs"."finished_at" IS NULL)
      )

memory_items_user_edit_shape_check.name: memory_items_user_edit_shape_check
memory_items_user_edit_shape_check.value:
(
        ("memory_items"."origin" = 'automatic' AND "memory_items"."user_edited_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("memory_items"."origin" = 'user_edited' AND "memory_items"."user_edited_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )

relationship_summary_executions_tokens_c.name: relationship_summary_executions_tokens_check
relationship_summary_executions_tokens_c.value:
"relationship_summary_executions"."estimated_input_tokens" >= 0 AND "relationship_summary_executions"."estimated_output_tokens" >= 0
      AND ("relationship_summary_executions"."input_tokens" IS NULL OR "relationship_summary_executions"."input_tokens" >= 0)
      AND ("relationship_summary_executions"."output_tokens" IS NULL OR "relationship_summary_executions"."output_tokens" >= 0)
      AND "relationship_summary_executions"."latency_ms" >= 0

relationship_summary_executions_receipt_.name: relationship_summary_executions_receipt_shape
relationship_summary_executions_receipt_.value:
("relationship_summary_executions"."settled_at" IS NULL OR ("relationship_summary_executions"."response_at" IS NOT NULL AND "relationship_summary_executions"."summary" IS NULL))
      AND ("relationship_summary_executions"."summary" IS NULL OR (CHAR_LENGTH("relationship_summary_executions"."summary") <= 4000 AND OCTET_LENGTH("relationship_summary_executions"."summary") <= 16000))

relationship_summary_runs_usage_shape_ch.name: relationship_summary_runs_usage_shape_check
relationship_summary_runs_usage_shape_ch.value:
(
        ("relationship_summary_runs"."input_tokens" IS NULL AND "relationship_summary_runs"."output_tokens" IS NULL AND "relationship_summary_runs"."usage_estimated" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("relationship_summary_runs"."input_tokens" IS NOT NULL AND "relationship_summary_runs"."output_tokens" IS NOT NULL AND "relationship_summary_runs"."usage_estimated" IS NOT NULL)
      )

relationship_summary_runs_terminal_shape.name: relationship_summary_runs_terminal_shape_check
relationship_summary_runs_terminal_shape.value:
(
        ("relationship_summary_runs"."status" IN ('complete', 'failed', 'dead_letter', 'cancelled') AND "relationship_summary_runs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("relationship_summary_runs"."status" IN ('pending', 'queued', 'running', 'retrying') AND "relationship_summary_runs"."finished_at" IS NULL)
      )
